desc:
The EKRON .30 CAL suppressor delivers the same cutting-edge engineering and low back pressure performance as our 5.56 model, now designed for .30 caliber platforms up to .308/7.62 NATO. Built using 3D-printed Grade 5 (ELI) Titanium, the EKRON offers exceptional strength in a lightweight, compact package—perfect for demanding rifle applications. Its patent-pending gas flow system is designed to minimize back pressure, improving firearm function and reducing excess gas at the shooter’s face.

Larger bore options available for bulk orders
